title: Lahore Fort

terrainReference.basis: Original provider elevation near the center of the fort interior.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Lahore Fort way 105841051 (Q613720) and individual mapped buildings and walls.
mapIdentity.scope: Eighteen named source features and additional exact building or wall ways plus the sampled outer northern rampart. The surveyed southern wall sections are respected and the principal southern approach remains open.

note: The 17 m average Picture Wall height comes from the conservation record. Gate, parapets and buildings are scaled estimates from mapped widths, historical images and written records. Foundations extend into the original terrain, with no ground cutout.
